orig.text:
6 days and $40,000 of compute with GPT-5.6 Sol to find a critical vulnerability in Chrome, claiming Google’s first full-chain reward in 2026 for a vulnerability that would affect an estimated 1 billion users. Highlights the opportunity for defenders to utilize these tools to find and fix vulnerabilities before attackers do.

引用 @oegerikus：For the second time in Google Chrome’s history, Google awarded a $250,000 bounty for a full-chain exploit to @XBOW. At an all-hands at the start of 2026 in Malta, I set the team a crazy challenge: a full-chain exploit of Chrome by the annual Black Hat conference.
